title: Verify Remember Me login persistence on TTA Cart
feature: authentication remember me persistent session browser restart
validity_rationale: The TTA Cart login page was inspected with Playwright MCP on 2026-11-05 and exposes Username, Password, and Login only; no Remember Me control exists. This scenario is not executable on this application unless the requirement or application changes.
description: Attempt to locate and select a Remember Me checkbox or toggle, then restart the browser profile and verify the session remains authenticated.
expected_result: BLOCKED on current TTA Cart: the required Remember Me control is absent. Do not treat ordinary login persistence as evidence for Remember Me.

title: Successful login with a supported standard user
validity_rationale: Supported positive login flow documented for the practice application.
description: Open the TTA Cart login page, enter a provisioned valid standard-user account, submit Login, and inspect the resulting page.
expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the Products page is displayed.
source: Playwright MCP observed successful login on 2026-11-05

title: Reject login when credentials are empty
validity_rationale: A negative form-validation test; verify the UI message before asserting its exact wording.
description: Submit the login form without entering a username or password.
expected_result: Login is not successful and the user remains on the login page with required-field feedback.
source: Curated TTA Cart test-design reference; behavior not yet browser-verified

title: Complete the TTA Cart checkout happy path
validity_rationale: Checkout totals and the order-complete confirmation were observed in the TTA Cart browser flow.
description: With the first listed product in the cart, provide checkout information, continue to the overview, verify the displayed order totals, and finish the practice order.
expected_result: The overview shows item total $15.99, tax $1.28, total $17.27; finishing displays Thank you for your order!.
